# RPtM Converter

> Free and open source Resource Pack to Mod Converter tool.

RPtM Converter is a web application that allows users to instantly convert Minecraft resource packs into Fabric mods directly in their browser.

## Features
- Browser-based conversion (no installation required)
- Supports multiple resource packs
- Custom icon support
- Generates Fabric mods

## Requirements
- [MPtMLib](https://modrinth.com/mod/rptmlib/) is required to run the generated mods.
